title: Services
empty: Add a service and define your remote command buttons.
executeHint: Review the host and script before execution.
deleteHint: This removes the saved commands and links. The remote service keeps running.
trustHint: Verify this fingerprint with the server administrator.
name: Service name
hostHint: Choose the host where commands should run; it may differ from the forwarding host.
noEnvironment: Do not send local environment variables
scriptHint: Scripts are saved locally. Do not include secrets. Use absolute paths or initialize your environment explicitly; interactive shell aliases are not guaranteed.
notReadiness: Command succeeded; service readiness has not been checked.
truncated: Older output was discarded to keep memory bounded.

error.invalidService: Check the template name and commands.
error.invalidAction: Check command fields, timeout and exit codes.
error.serviceBusy: Wait for this service’s current task to finish.
error.staleAction: Configuration changed. Reopen and review the action.
error.ruleMissing: A linked forward no longer exists.
error.hostBlocked: Resolve the host configuration diagnostics first.
error.sessionOptions: Session options need attention. Explicitly choose not to send local environment variables for SendEnv.
error.authentication: Authentication failed. Supply credentials to retry before execution.
error.hostKey: Host fingerprint was rejected or changed.
error.connectionTimeout: SSH connection timed out; command was not executed.
error.connectionFailed: SSH connection failed; command was not executed.
error.remoteUnknown: Stopped waiting locally; the remote process state is unknown. Check its state before running again.
error.exitCode: Command returned an unsuccessful exit code.
error.backupFailed: Could not back up the existing configuration.
error.hostUsedByService: This host is referenced by a remote service.
error.unauthorizedWindow: This window cannot execute remote commands.
error.invalidProbe: Check probe commands, mappings, intervals and limits.
error.startActionMissing: Select a non-interactive start action first.
error.probeFailed: Probe failed; no service state is inferred.
error.unmappedStatus: Exit code has no status mapping.
error.invalidStatusJson: Status output does not match the strict JSON format.
error.unmappedHealth: Exit code has no health mapping.
error.statusUnknown: Service is not confirmed running; the operation was paused.
error.forwardRemoteCommand: Disable the forward’s legacy remote command before combining it with a service action.
error.forwardFailed: Forward connection failed. Existing resources were preserved.
error.forwardChanged: Forward configuration or connection generation changed.
error.forwardTimeout: Forward connection wait timed out; check its current state.
error.serviceDisabled: Review and enable this service before executing it.
error.servicePackageLimit: Service package exceeds size or item limits.

service.probeHint: Only selected probes run automatically after an explicit action. No background monitoring.
service.statusConfirmHint: Disable confirmation on the selected status action before using it as a probe.
service.jsonHint: Strict JSON: {"state":"running"}. States: running, stopped, failed, unknown. Optional ready/message; readiness uses its own probe.
service.remoteProbe: Checks run on the SSH host selected by the current forward; localhost refers to that host.
service.repeatable: Safe to repeat this read-only probe
service.repeatHint: Only enable for read-only commands. Automatic waiting never overlaps probes or repeats a start command.
service.connectHint: Without a status probe, each combined operation explicitly runs the selected start command. Without health checks, readiness stays unverified. Dedicated terminals require manual checks.
service.connectReview: This may run the reviewed start command and probes, then connect “{{forward}}”. Existing forwards are preserved. Failure never automatically stops the service.
service.createdForward: This operation created a forward connection.

sharing.environmentDefault: Use the host’s configured environment policy
sharing.exportHint: Scripts may contain secrets. Review every selected service before sharing. Credentials, trust and results are excluded.
sharing.importHint: Imported services stay disabled. Repeated health checks and checks after actions are turned off. Review and enable each service separately.
sharing.nameConflict: A unique service name will be created.
sharing.enableHint: Review the template scripts and probes. The referencing forward selects the host; enabling does not execute commands.
sharing.importStopped: Import does not connect to SSH or run commands. Imported forwards stay stopped with auto-connect off.
sharing.previewHint: Review hosts, forwards and service scripts. Selected items are added as copies without replacing existing entries.

templates.title: Service templates
templates.hint: Import the name, color, icon and all commands, then edit and save.
templates.replaceHint: Replaces the current draft’s name, color, icon, commands and check settings.

noServices: No services. Add one on the Services page.

builder.title: Command and arguments
builder.hint: Leave the parameter name blank for a positional argument; leave its value blank for a flag.

boundTargetHint: The execution host follows the linked forward.

review.enableHint: Enable these commands for use from linked forwards.

copyService: Create a service from this one
